preconditions.description: N is an integer representing the board size between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(knightPos, (list, tuple)) and len(knightPos) == 2 and all(1 <= x <= N for x in knightPos)
preconditions.description: knightPos is a sequence of two integers representing 1-based coordinates within the board bounds.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(targetPos, (list, tuple)) and len(targetPos) == 2 and all(1 <= x <= N for x in targetPos)
preconditions.description: targetPos is a sequence of two integers representing 1-based coordinates within the board bounds.

postconditions.description: The return value is an integer.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 if knightPos == targetPos else (return_value >= 0 and return_value == min_steps(knightPos, targetPos, N))
postconditions.description: If start equals target, return 0 (handled by min_steps logic returning 0). Otherwise, return_value is the minimum number of valid knight moves required to reach targetPos from knightPos on an N x N board, or -1 if unreachable. Note: On a connected board, a knight can always reach any square, so -1 is theoretically impossible for valid inputs, but the function signature allows it.
